findings.title: Declared Node.js version is below the upgrade target
findings.message: .node-version pins Node.js 22.11.0, below the target Node.js 26. This declaration is below the upgrade target. A version pin (such as `.nvmrc`) makes the tools that read it keep running the old Node.js after the upgrade. An `engines.node` range doesn't select a runtime: it only excludes the target version, and npm treats it as advisory unless `engine-strict` is set.
findings.fix: Update this declaration to the target's major version.

findings.title: Node.js version sources disagree
findings.message: .node-version pins Node.js 22.11.0, but apps/web/.nvmrc pins lts/iron (Node.js 20). Two version pins that apply to this package (such as `.nvmrc` and `.node-version`) name different major versions, or a pin names a major version that the package's `engines.node` range excludes. When pins differ, tools that read different pins run different versions, so an upgrade that passes locally can still run the old runtime elsewhere. An `engines.node` range doesn't select a runtime: it says which versions the package works on, and npm treats it as advisory unless `engine-strict` is set.
findings.fix: Make every pin and the engines.node range agree on one major version.

findings.title: Declared Node.js version is past end-of-life
findings.message: apps/web/.nvmrc pins lts/iron (Node.js 20), which reached end-of-life on 2026-04-30. This Node.js release line has reached End-Of-Life: it no longer receives updates, including security patches, which can leave the application exposed to issues that will never be fixed.
findings.fix: Move this declaration to an Active LTS or Maintenance LTS release.
